problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 10 delivery trucks to transport packages through 10 different distribution hubs.

Each truck carries a package that must pass through hubs in a predetermined sequence represented as (Hub, Handling time), where each pair specifies the hub where the package must be processed and the time required for handling. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which hubs must be visited.

Package details:
* P1 requires the route: (H5, 9) → (H1, 4) → (H8, 9) → (H3, 10) → (H9, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H2, 9) → (H6, 9) → (H4, 5) → (H7, 9)
* P2 requires the route: (H4, 9) → (H3, 3) → (H9, 2) → (H8, 6) → (H1, 7) → (H6, 2) → (H7, 3) → (H2, 1) → (H10, 7) → (H5, 9)
* P3 requires the route: (H1, 2) → (H5, 2) → (H6, 5) → (H2, 5) → (H10, 8) → (H8, 1) → (H9, 2) → (H4, 7) → (H3, 4) → (H7, 5)
* P4 requires the route: (H5, 2) → (H2, 7) → (H3, 5) → (H10, 6) → (H1, 5) → (H8, 1) → (H7, 3) → (H9, 8) → (H4, 6) → (H6, 4)
* P5 requires the route: (H4, 5) → (H2, 9) → (H7, 7) → (H3, 1) → (H5, 6) → (H1, 4) → (H9, 8) → (H6, 10) → (H8, 10) → (H10, 4)
* P6 requires the route: (H8, 2) → (H9, 6) → (H2, 7) → (H4, 7) → (H10, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H5, 3) → (H6, 6) → (H1, 7) → (H7, 7)
* P7 requires the route: (H9, 1) → (H5, 6) → (H4, 7) → (H7, 2) → (H2, 2) → (H1, 10) → (H8, 9) → (H10, 10) → (H3, 1) → (H6, 6)
* P8 requires the route: (H3, 3) → (H10, 8) → (H6, 3) → (H4, 8) → (H7, 3) → (H9, 7) → (H5, 9) → (H2, 6) → (H8, 6) → (H1, 2)
* P9 requires the route: (H1, 10) → (H3, 1) → (H6, 2) → (H9, 8) → (H8, 9) → (H2, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H7, 1) → (H5, 8) → (H4, 8)
* P10 requires the route: (H2, 5) → (H4, 5) → (H10, 1) → (H8, 6) → (H7, 10) → (H5, 1) → (H6, 6) → (H9, 3) → (H3, 7) → (H1, 2)

Each package must be processed continuously once it starts at a hub and cannot be interrupted, and each hub can only handle one package at a time. The objective is to determine the processing schedule for all packages at the hubs so that the total completion time for all packages is minimized.
